title: Swiss Glaciers Lose More Ice in 2026
paragraphs: Swiss glaciers are big rivers of ice. They are in the mountains. This year they lost a lot of ice.
The winter had little snow. The summer was very hot. In summer, it was warm even high in the mountains.
Two small glaciers are now gone. In five years, Switzerland lost nearly 20 percent of its glacier ice.

questions.q: How much ice did Switzerland lose in five years?
